text:
aj_support: Escalating GALETECH (trial) — high-severity onboarding disruption. Customers report 500s from embed endpoint since 03/18, spikes after high-volume test. Renewal in 12 days, usage ramping. Support reproduced; looks like request throttling + retry-loop with stale token. Need CS to own comms and renewal risk mitigation. Logs + minimal repro below.
aj_support: Relevant logs: ```ERROR: embed-service: 500 downstream timeout; retry header: X-Retry-After=30``` and request snippet: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"input":"..."}'```
maria_cs: Ack. Thanks for the quick triage. Marking as P1 for renewal risk. @dave_csm will you take lead on customer comms? We should loop in success-ops for a temporary SLA/discount if needed.
dave_csm: I got it. I'll set up an immediate customer touchpoint. Proposed next steps: 1) quick acknowledgement email within 1h, 2) provide workaround + ETA for fix, 3) schedule EBR within 48h if issue persists, 4) consider temporary quota bump. Who can confirm ETA from eng?
zoe_success_ops: On it — I'll coordinate with eng infra. Can someone paste the incident link + any assigned eng oncall? Also need a short comms template I can use.
aj_support: oncall-bot linked the incident: <https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-238|INC-2026-238> — assigned to eng-runtime (sre-team). Current note: patch candidate targeted EOD tomorrow. No hotfix yet.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-238 updated: priority=P1, assignee=eng-runtime, status=investigating.
maria_cs: Draft comms (please edit): "Hi <Account Team>, we see embed errors affecting some requests. We're actively investigating with engineering and expect a patch by EOD tomorrow. For immediate relief, we can temporarily increase request quota and enable client-side exponential backoff. We'll follow up with a root-cause and next steps." :pray:
dave_csm: That draft works. I'll send it and propose a 30-min sync after they acknowledge. Also will surface renewal timeline and propose a goodwill credit if impact continues past patch ETA.
zoe_success_ops: I'll prepare the quota bump playbook and a short checklist for CS handoff: 1) confirm account contact and escalation POA, 2) apply quota bump (ops runbook), 3) schedule EBR, 4) capture impact metrics for credit decision.
aj_support: Added repro artifacts to the thread: stack traces + sample payloads. Let me know if you need me on the call.
dave_csm: Please include me on any eng standups re: this incident. I'll own customer updates and credit negotiation if required.
maria_cs: I'll open a renewal watch doc and tag finance for potential pro-rated credit approval. @zoe_success_ops please ping me once quota bump is applied so I can confirm with the customer.
zoe_success_ops: Will do. ETA for ops task: 2 hours to validate and apply temporary quota. I'll update thread when done.
oncall-bot: ENG update: initial mitigation identified (retry-loop guard), patch in internal review.
dave_csm: Quick checklist before I email: 1) quirk reproduced and mitigation path? yes. 2) quota bump tested? pending. 3) patch ETA confirmed? EOD tomorrow. If any of these change, I won't send until confirmed.
maria_cs: Sounds good. Thanks team. Keep updates short here — we'll assemble comms and send once quota is ready or patch ETA slips. :thumbsup:
aj_support: Thanks — standing by for any info"
